authorization_source: User-directed continuation after clean review of the workload-control-v2 integration: one terminal-only 60-case semantic baseline, then the predetermined 30-case source audit only if operationally valid.
execution_rule: Invoke only the registered operation wrapper from a terminal after ChatGPT/Codex and browsers are closed. The durable marker is created before remote review, imports, service preflight, monitoring, or child launch. Every outcome consumes the permission.
validity_rule: Only workload_control_v2_completion.json may establish operational eligibility. Require all 60 unique captures and evaluations, exact frozen model/index/service identity, active awake protection, valid one-second cadence, terminal-only execution, no hard-control failure, and no B_CONSECUTIVE_10 trigger.
on_failure: Preserve all staging, raw monitor evidence, marker, and outcome as invalid diagnostic evidence. Do not retry, reset the marker, relax controls, or change the benchmark.
post_valid_run: Publish byte-identical SHA-keyed artifacts, complete exactly the frozen 30-case source audit, verify denominators and evidence, and obtain a fresh final review before PR31 merge.
unchanged_scope: No benchmark membership, gold, scorer, production runtime, prompts, models, provider settings, retry budget, 120-second timeout, schedule, disabled-judge policy, or historical artifact changes.
